reviewedRevision: 9949c1a plus the rework in this commit
process: Lean final review at the user's request: the known 3-field shortfall went straight to a retrofit, followed by one independent review round. Three small LOW fixes (hint deduction loop, field 5 tip, sector labels) were verified by re-running the reviewer's own solver and generator probes, one clean-worktree run and the browser check, without a second review round.
independentProbes: The reviewer's own backtracking solver, playing only from public state, cleared 3,000 of 3,000 fields (150 seeds per field, random first tap) without a guess; no first tap was unsafe. Across 8,000 generations no field needed more than 25 of its 400 attempts, so generation never failed. getState() exposed no mine or hidden number while a field was live. On the final files the same solver cleared 600 of 600 fields with 0 of 2,784 hint calls missing a provable safe tile. Blind play won at most 5% of any field from 3 (random keys on field 4); fuzz, determinism at 30, 60 and 120 Hz, broken progress stores and EN/ZH text fit all passed.

findings.observation: Only 3 fields built from builder branches, with no select or continue. There are now 20 data-driven fields with rubble, pillars, gates, moats and diagonal rifts and rules such as probes, pre-opened tiles, sector totals, flag limits and hints, each with an accurate EN/ZH tip, plus a field select and env.progress continue; the 956-line file is split into seven modules.

Fields could require guessing. Mines are now placed after the first tap, which is always safe with its neighbours, and each field is regenerated until a pure-logic solver clears it; H points only at proven-safe tiles, and getState() hides mines during play.

Review finding: H could miss a provable safe tile that needed mines found in the same pass; the deduction now repeats until nothing changes. The field 5 tip was corrected, sector totals read 'S1: 5 mines' / '1区：5雷', and a failed field generation now shows a notice instead of throwing.

openNotes: Field generation runs on the first tap and can take up to about half a second on the largest fields (1.4 s once on a heavily loaded machine).
Flags are never needed to win, so flag limits only constrain marking.
The smallest board cells are about 17 px on a phone.

browser.method: Official Claude in Chrome extension, local server; real clicks on Start, the language switch, the field select, board tiles and the touch buttons, synthetic in-page keys; only DOM text and the canvas were read.
observed: English: Start opened field 1 of 20 (Camp Survey, 6x6, 4 mines) with the tip below the board.
English loss: a driver error revealed a mine and the loss screen explained it; Play again restarted the field.
English win: Space opened the safe first area, then repeating H and Space revealed A1, B1, A2, A3, B3 and A4 to 32 of 32 safe tiles; SITE MAPPED appeared and Enter travelled to field 2 (Tent Row).

Chinese 390 px phone frame (388 px inner, no horizontal overflow): the field select showed fields 1-2 unlocked; a tap opened field 2, a tap on the board opened the safe area, the 推理 button proved G1 safe and the 揭开 button revealed it (31 of 36 safe).
